places.name: Old Irontown
places.description: Irontown was founded in 1868, as a second attempt to mine iron from the nearby Iron Mountain.

places.name: Nellie Pucell Unthank Memorial
places.description: A monument to a survivor of harsh pioneer life, frostbite, and primitive surgery.

places.name: Page Ranch House
places.description: Built at the turn of the 20th century, using bricks made and fired from clay found on the property.
